articles.title: Standard Chartered offers RLUSD custody in Dubai and plans LMAX collateral link
articles.snippet: Ripple previously gave LMAX $150 million in financing to integrate RLUSD into its institutional infrastructure.

articles.title: Altcoins rally on thin trading as bitcoin holds below $83,500
articles.snippet: The CoinDesk 80 has risen around 3% in 24 hours, more than double the CoinDesk 5, while spot bitcoin ETFs lost $681 million last week.

articles.title: Tokenized commodities look beyond gold as lending and oil open new markets
articles.snippet: Paxos Labs, Theo and Energy Substantiation execs see growth coming from putting physical assets to work, with precious metals leading and energy presenting a tougher test.

articles.title: Kraken parent clears Dubai’s final hurdle for dirham trading rollout
articles.snippet: Payward received full market approval from Dubai’s VARA to expand its digital asset services in the UAE, building on the preliminary approval received in May.

articles.title: Standard Chartered Will Hold Ripple's Stablecoin in Dubai—And Let Clients Trade With It Without Moving It
articles.snippet: The bank's Dubai branch now offers custody for Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin and plans a link with LMAX that lets institutions post it as trading collateral while the coins stay put.
